answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a small refundable stake in shared escrow before trading, slashed on proven fraud. New identities cannot multiply like a zephyr breeze swelling into a gale: each fake agent must fund its own walnut-sized deposit, so spinning up ten thousand sock-puppets costs ten thousand stakes. Honest agents earn their deposit back with interest from fees, making identity cheap for the real and ruinous for the fake.
